say.speaker: starly
say.text: Incoming from above! Need three extra sets of wings and paws, {lord}?!

say.speaker: partner
say.text: Starly?! Caterpie?! Pawmi?! What on earth are you three doing all the way at the capital?!

say.speaker: pawmi
say.text: We trailed your footprints over the mountain the whole way! You didn't think you could sneak off on a royal expedition without telling us what was going on, did you?!

say.speaker: caterpie
say.text: Whatever those terrifying Rift monsters are, our hometown squad fights together! Count us in!

say.speaker: lord
say.text: Best timing we could ever ask for! Form up on our flank, everyone, and let's drive these Rift beasts back!
